levels.surface: أبو العباس أحمد بن يحيى بن زكريا القطان
بكر بن عبد الله بن حبيب

notes: needs ruling: the bracketed opening «[... رفعه إلى أبي عبد الله ... و]» is an editorial insertion carrying a different chain with no saying of its own; it is read as its own group, and the report holds two isnads (rule 11)
«رفعه إلى» names the Imam right after it, so no unnamed gap is written; «قلت لعبد الله بن العباس»: Ibn ʿAbbās is the one asked and answers, so he is the last link (rule 5)
